title: goniopteris imitata

This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Goniopteris imitata are believed to be due to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, although more research is needed to fully understand its effects. Additionally, studies have shown that Goniopteris imitata has potential in treating various ailments, including wounds, fever, and digestive issues, but more research is necessary to confirm these uses.
